import json,hashlib,zlib,base64
from ghidra.program.model.address import AddressSet
from ghidra.program.model.pcode import JumpTable
from ghidra.app.decompiler import DecompInterface
from ghidra.program.flatapi import FlatProgramAPI
from java.util import ArrayList
p=currentProgram;fm=p.getFunctionManager();api=FlatProgramAPI(p,monitor);af=p.getAddressFactory()
def a(x):return af.getAddress(x.removeprefix("0x"))
start,end=a("140aef1f0"),a("140af00a4")
raw=bytes(x&255 for x in api.getBytes(start,int(end.subtract(start))))
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()=="0cc159e97b1f808142a9a67ddb2d072171dc7e93ebabd404597dcc5be41b12c5", "Original code SHA mismatch"
f=fm.getFunctionAt(start);old=int(f.getBody().getNumAddresses());overlaps=[]
rows=[("140aef9c3",["140aef71a","140aef9c5","140aefa80","140aefbc0"])]
tx=p.startTransaction("M02 terrain edit original bounded body and four-case RNE jump table")
try:
 body=AddressSet(start,end.subtract(1))
 for other in fm.getFunctionsOverlapping(body):
  if other.getEntryPoint()!=start:
   overlaps.append(dict(address=str(other.getEntryPoint()),name=other.getName(),bytes=int(other.getBody().getNumAddresses())))
   body.delete(other.getBody())
 f.setBody(body)
 for jump,targets in rows:
  cases=ArrayList()
  for target in targets:cases.add(a(target))
  JumpTable(a(jump),cases,True,0).writeOverride(f)
 p.endTransaction(tx,True)
except:
 p.endTransaction(tx,False);raise
api.disassemble(start)
di=DecompInterface()
try:
 di.openProgram(p);d=di.decompileFunction(f,60,monitor)
 print(json.dumps(dict(sha256=p.getExecutableSHA256(),code_sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),old=old,body=int(f.getBody().getNumAddresses()),overlaps=overlaps,completed=d.decompileCompleted(),error=str(d.getErrorMessage()),gz=base64.b64encode(zlib.compress(d.getDecompiledFunction().getC().encode())).decode() if d.decompileCompleted() else None)))
finally:di.dispose()
